crossRefs.note: All of Mount Sinai smoked, because Yahweh descended on it in fire; and its smoke ascended like the smoke of a furnace…
When Moses entered into the Tent, the pillar of cloud descended, stood at the door of the Tent, and Yahweh spoke with…
I will come down and talk with you there. I will take of the Spirit which is on you, and will put it on them; and they…
Yahweh came down in the cloud, and spoke to him, and took of the Spirit that was on him, and put it on the seventy…
It came to pass, when the priests had come out of the holy place, that the cloud filled Yahweh’s house,
While he said these things, a cloud came and overshadowed them, and they were afraid as they entered into the cloud.
A voice came out of the cloud, saying, “This is my beloved Son. Listen to him!”
He said, “I will make all my goodness pass before you, and will proclaim Yahweh’s name before you. I will be gracious…
Now please let the power of the Lord be great, according as you have spoken, saying,
For I will proclaim Yahweh’s name. Ascribe greatness to our God!
that men may declare Yahweh’s name in Zion, and his praise in Jerusalem;
Yahweh’s name is a strong tower: the righteous run to him, and are safe.
Hear Yahweh’s word, you rulers of Sodom! Listen to the law of our God, you people of Gomorrah!

translations.web: Yahweh descended in the cloud, and stood with him there, and proclaimed Yahweh’s name.
translations.bsb: And the LORD descended in a cloud, stood with him there, and proclaimed His name, the LORD.
translations.kjv: And the LORD descended in the cloud, and stood with him there, and proclaimed the name of the LORD.
translations.asv: And Jehovah descended in the cloud, and stood with him there, and proclaimed the name of Jehovah.
